cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID. An Agadez report of August 2026 has the same official saying about 3 million lack the card, which would give about 36%; the later Diffa and Niamey reports both put holders at about 3 million.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-07: on 7 October 2026 the director general said fewer than 3 million hold the card (NER-003), confirming the Diffa reading of about 11% of the population. Nothing counts a third.
